title: Inheritance: boats of a new kind

terminal.description: A shell in your workspace. Run the boats here, and try your new kinds from main.

tasks.title: Write BikeFerry, a boat that carries bikes
tasks.description:
Under `// Task 1`, write a class `BikeFerry` that extends `Boat`. It adds an `int bikeSpaces`, a constructor `BikeFerry(String name, int seats, int bikeSpaces)` that hands the name and the seats to `Boat`'s constructor, and a method `int getBikeSpaces()`. Use `Boat` as the starter gives it.

Check makes bike ferries of its own, two at once included, keeps one in a variable of type `Boat`, and reads what `getName`, `getSeats`, `fareFor`, `describe` and `getBikeSpaces` give back. A `BikeFerry` that is not a `Boat` does not compile there.
nextSteps: Read the parts of the lesson about extends and about the parent's constructor.
Write the first line of the class so that a BikeFerry is a Boat.
Write the field and the constructor: Boat's part first, then the bike spaces.
Write getBikeSpaces, then take the // off the BikeFerry lines in main and run the file.
hints: A BikeFerry already has a name and seats: it gets them from Boat. It adds only the bike spaces.
name and seats are private in Boat, so BikeFerry cannot set them. Boat's constructor sets them, and the first line of BikeFerry's constructor runs it with super(...).
The constructor's shape: `super(name, seats);` then `this.bikeSpaces = bikeSpaces;`.

tasks.title: Write NightBoat, with a fare of its own
tasks.description:
Under `// Task 2`, write a class `NightBoat` that extends `Boat`, with a constructor `NightBoat(String name, int seats)`. It overrides `fareFor`, with `@Override` on the line above: at night under 16 travel free and everyone else pays 450.

Check makes night boats of its own, keeps them in variables of type `Boat`, and reads what `fareFor` gives back for ages on both sides of 16, and what `getName` and `describe` give back. Then it looks for `@Override` above `fareFor`.
nextSteps: Read the part of the lesson about overriding and @Override.
Write the class and its constructor, handing both values to Boat.
Write fareFor with exactly the first line Boat's has, and @Override above it.
Take the // off the NightBoat lines in main and run the file: the boat is in a Boat variable.
hints: Through a variable of type Boat, Java runs NightBoat's fareFor only if it takes the place of Boat's.
It takes Boat's place only when the name and the parameter types are exactly Boat's: int fareFor(int age). With @Override above it, the compiler tells you when they are not.
The method: `@Override` on its own line, then `int fareFor(int age) {`, giving back 0 when age is below 16 and 450 otherwise.

tasks.title: Write CharterBoat, which says who hired it
tasks.description:
Under `// Task 3`, write a class `CharterBoat` that extends `Boat`. It adds a `String hiredBy` and a constructor `CharterBoat(String name, int seats, String hiredBy)`, and overrides `describe`, with `@Override` on the line above: it gives back what `Boat`'s own `describe` gives back, then `, hired by ` and the name, as in `Petrel: 6 seats, hired by Struan`. The first part comes from `Boat`'s `describe` itself, not written again.

Check runs your class beside a `Boat` of its own, with the same methods, whose `describe` words things its own way. It makes charter boats, two at once included, keeps them in variables of type `Boat`, and reads what `describe`, `getName` and `fareFor` give back. Then it looks for `@Override` above `describe`.
nextSteps: Read the part of the lesson about calling the parent's version.
Write the class, its field and its constructor.
Write describe with @Override, asking Boat's describe for the first part.
Take the // off the CharterBoat lines in main and run the file.
hints: Boat already knows how to describe a boat. CharterBoat only adds who hired it.
Inside CharterBoat, describe() alone means CharterBoat's own describe, which would call itself forever. The lesson shows the word that reaches the parent's version instead.
The shape: `return super.describe() + ", hired by " + hiredBy;`.
